subject: vela.claim-record.v1 relations[].kind
not_this_field: `evidence[].relation` is a different axis: it names the role an Artifact plays for one Claim, never a link between two Claims. Every retained Claim Record spells it `supports`. Nothing here applies to it.
note: Two vocabularies over one field. The correction algebra is closed and authoritative: acceptance acts on it and Standing moves. Descriptive relations are retained context that no Decision reads. Near-miss spellings resolve to one canonical name so a consumer matching the canonical form cannot silently miss retained records.

descriptive_relations.enumerated_from: the four maintained Frontiers, not from intent

census.note: Descriptive observation, not an assertion this fixture verifies. The Frontiers are separate repositories; a checker inside this one cannot reach them. Reproduce with the command below and expect drift as Frontiers advance.
census.separation: Every `supersedes` sits on a revision-2 Claim whose sole provenance is a `submission`. Every other relation sits on a revision-1 Claim imported from a corpus. No correction relation has ever been written by an import, and no descriptive relation has ever appeared on a revised Claim.

never_written.note: Spellings PROTOCOL.md declared through 0.966.3 that no repository has ever recorded. `opposes` and `depends_on` survive as recognised aliases of the spellings that are recorded. `revises` and `retracts` are dropped: retraction moves Standing through the `claim.withdraw` Proposal action and needs no relation, and nothing ever emitted or read `revises`.
